contract.handler_coordinates: The row processors publish aligned camera coordinates to FF7DB0/FF7DB2 before dispatching each nonzero interaction selector.
contract.spawn_coordinates: The generic interaction spawners add FFF150/FFF152 to FF7DB0/FF7DB2 before storing the actor's world position.
contract.wrapper_values: The row wrappers initialize the offsets to -0x10 and 0xF0.

conclusion: The four words are a complete interaction dispatch coordinate scratch contract, not persistent actor or camera state.
